heroIntro: Under Section 82 of the Local Government (City Corporation) Act 2009 and Section 125 of the Income Tax Act 2023, businesses in Bangladesh must renew their trade license every fiscal year starting July 1. Online renewal combines statutory trade fees, signboard charges, 15% VAT, and mandatory source tax.

sections.title: Legal Requirement and Fiscal Renewal Timeline
sections.content:
Operating any shop, office, consultancy, e-commerce warehouse, or factory without an updated annual trade license violates Section 82 and the Model Tax Schedules of the Local Government (City Corporation) Act 2009. Whether organized as a sole proprietorship, registered partnership firm, or private limited company incorporated under the Companies Act 1994, every commercial entity in Bangladesh must renew its license each fiscal year beginning 1 July.

Scheduled banks immediately freeze corporate current accounts, LC openings, merchant gateways, and commercial credit lines if a valid current-year trade license is missing during Know Your Customer (KYC) audits. Furthermore, RJSC annual returns, import registration certificates (IRC), export registration certificates (ERC), and BIDA filings all require a verified active license copy.

Major city corporations also permit five-year multi-year renewals upon paying aggregated annual statutory fees, saving entrepreneurs repeated administrative trips while ensuring uninterrupted municipal standing alongside monthly VAT return compliance and routine municipal inspection readiness.

sections.title: Breakdown of Trade License Renewal Fees and Source Tax
sections.content:
Total renewal cost is never a single flat charge; it bundles municipal trade category fees, signboard tax, 15 percent VAT under the VAT and Supplementary Duty Act 2012, and advance income tax collected at source under Section 125 of the Income Tax Act 2023. Official charges vary strictly by business classification, floor location, and city tier; figures below are indicative only, and the municipality's official fee schedule governs.

Cost ComponentLegal BasisHow It Is Calculated
Base Business Category FeeCity Corporation / Pourashava Tax ScheduleFixed by trade type (IT, consultancy, trading, factory)
Signboard ChargeMunicipal Tax ScheduleCharged per square foot (minimum base slab applies)
Value Added Tax (VAT)VAT & SD Act 201215% applied on municipal license and signboard fees
Advance Income Tax (AIT / Source Tax)Income Tax Act 2023, Sec. 125BDT 500–3,000+ depending on City Corporation or district

Preserve the bank payment slip carefully: Section 125 source tax paid during trade license renewal is credited as adjustable advance tax inside your annual income tax filing each assessment year.

sections.title: Step-by-Step Online Renewal Process for DNCC and DSCC
sections.content:
Dhaka North (DNCC) and Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) process digital trade license renewals under City Corporation Model Tax rules through integrated e-Trade portals linked to NBR and commercial banks. Completing renewal before the fiscal grace period avoids statutory monthly surcharges and mobile court fines:

  1. Access the Municipal Portal: Log into your City Corporation e-Trade License portal using the existing business mobile number and current trade license registration number.
  2. Update Business Details and Signboard Dimensions: Confirm business address, signboard square footage, and nature of trade; upload an updated commercial lease or property ownership verification if premises changed.
  3. Generate Automated Demand Slip: Review the system-calculated fee breakdown combining municipal license fee, signboard fee, 15% VAT, and Section 125 advance source tax.
  4. Pay Digitally and Download QR Certificate: Pay via bKash, Nagad, debit card, or designated bank branch challan, then download the QR-coded renewed e-Trade License PDF immediately.

For businesses relocating premises, expanding business categories, or changing ownership structure, physical zone officer verification precedes online demand-slip generation.

sections.title: Documents Checklist for Trade License Renewal
sections.content:
Having updated tax, lease, and corporate governance records ready ensures your online or municipal counter renewal under the Local Government (City Corporation) Act 2009 clears without administrative holds. Missing lease stamps or expired PSR filings are the leading cause of delayed zone verification. Prepare clear digital scans and photocopies of these documents:

  • Existing or last renewed Trade License copy displaying the unique license tracking number and business activity classification code.
  • Previous fiscal year's fee payment receipt and bank challan proving all municipal dues and surcharges are cleared.
  • Updated commercial office lease agreement on non-judicial stamp paper, recent rent receipt, or holding tax receipt if owner-occupied.
  • Proprietor's or Managing Director's National ID copy, updated contact mobile number, and recent passport-size photograph.
  • Active business e-TIN status check / PSR confirmation and updated BIN (VAT registration) certificate where turnover thresholds require it.
  • For private limited companies: Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum & Articles of Association, and certified Form XII confirming current directors alongside RJSC incorporation records.

sections.title: Corporate Compliance Support and Chamber Consultation
sections.content:
Allowing a trade license to lapse over multiple years triggers compound municipal surcharges under the Model Tax Schedules, commercial bank account freezes, mobile court penalties, and severe regulatory hurdles when closing or selling a company. Even if an entity pauses active trading temporarily, keeping municipal compliance current—or formally executing company dissolution and license surrender—protects directors from accumulating liabilities and NBR non-filing notices.

faqs.question: When is the deadline to renew a trade license in Bangladesh without penalty?
faqs.answer: Trade licenses follow Bangladesh's fiscal year from 1 July to 30 June. City Corporations normally enforce renewal at the start of the fiscal year (July–September grace periods vary by municipal notification); missing the announced cutoff triggers monthly surcharge penalties under the Model Tax Schedule.

faqs.question: Can I renew my DNCC or DSCC trade license for five years at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both Dhaka North City Corporation and Dhaka South City Corporation permit eligible commercial businesses to renew trade licenses for up to five years in one cycle by multiplying applicable annual trade, signboard, VAT, and source-tax fees. Keep annual PSR tax compliance active separately.

faqs.question: Is income tax source tax mandatory during trade license renewal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under Section 125 of the Income Tax Act 2023, licensing authorities must collect specified advance income tax at source (ranging from BDT 500 in smaller areas up to BDT 3,000 in major city corporations) before issuing or renewing a trade license. This amount is credited against your annual tax return.

faqs.question: What happens if I stop doing business without canceling my trade license?
faqs.answer: If you close operations without formally surrendering the trade license to the City Corporation or municipality, annual renewal fees and late surcharges continue accruing in municipal ledgers. You should submit a formal closure petition with your last cleared receipt to permanently stop municipal billing.

faqs.question: Do I need a separate trade license for each branch office in Dhaka?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under the Local Government (City Corporation) Act 2009 and municipal taxation rules, each physical branch address, retail showroom, warehouse, or separate commercial activity operating under distinct premises requires its own location-specific trade license and signboard assessment matching its verified commercial lease.
